content: Independent verification pass completed 2026-05-18 BEFORE building v2 artifact -- deliberate verify-before-declare discipline applied at the synthesis layer rather than inheriting the deep-document citations. Three material corrections found, all load-bearing: (1) CITATION ERROR -- the forward-MR OR~1.41 (95% CI 1.09-1.83, tobacco-adjusted) belongs to Vaucher et al. 2018 Molecular Psychiatry 23:1287-1292, NOT Gage et al. 2017. Gage forward effect is much smaller (OR 1.04 per doubling cannabis-initiation odds); Gage anchors the REVERSE signal (schizophrenia liability -> cannabis use, OR 1.10, p=2.64e-5). The deep document propagated this miscitation; caught before publication. (2) THRESHOLD ARTIFACT -- the >=30% pain relief RD 0.09 / NNTB 11 / moderate certainty figure is the 2018 Mucke Cochrane (pub2), NOT the 2026 Ates update (pub3). The 2026 update re-stratifies by THC content and DOWNGRADES every 30% comparison to low/very-low certainty; the only sig finding (THC/CBD-balanced RD 0.07) is judged not clinically relevant by the authors. The pain-resolution narrative recorded earlier as ground_truth must be revised: the threshold-artifact framing is still directionally right but the specific reconciliation numbers were stale-source. (3) RoB language conflation -- 2026 Cochrane overall RoB is 6 low / 10 unclear / 5 high; the separate 14/21 figure is high-RoB-because-small, a different judgment. CONFIRMED accurate: Wang 2021 BMJ (vol 374 not 373), NASEM 2017 chronic-pain rating, Cooper 2013 design, Di Forti 2019 (daily OR 3.2 / high-potency daily OR 4.8), Santiago 2019, Heblinski 2020, Gertsch 2008 (E-BCP Ki 155+/-4 nM, sole terpene exception), Spindle/Vandrey 2024 limonene (N=20 proof-of-concept), Andre 2024 PRISMA. Pleiotropy state-of-art now anchored to Johnson 2024 Neuropsychopharm + Cheng 2023 Lancet Psych + Hindley 2022 Transl Psych: bidirectional causal channels survive MR-PRESSO outlier removal BUT horizontal pleiotropy widespread -- contributory model survives, clean unidirectional does not. LESSON REINFORCED: verify-before-declare at synthesis layer caught a load-bearing miscitation that 3 systems + collaborative pass all propagated. Shared-source convergence is exactly as fragile as predicted.
